# ViralHooks

> Free TikTok hook generator — enter a niche, get 3 AI-generated viral opening hooks plus a matching dance template, in seconds.

ViralHooks solves a specific creator problem: knowing how to open a TikTok video so people don't scroll past in the first 2 seconds. Enter your niche (fitness, real estate, skincare, coaching, and 50+ others) and get 3 AI-generated hook lines tailored to it, free, with no sign-up.

## Pages

- [Home](https://viralhooks.app/): The hook generator tool, plus an FAQ on what makes a TikTok hook work.
- [Blog](https://viralhooks.app/blog): Articles on viral TikTok content strategy.
- [TikTok Hook Examples](https://viralhooks.app/tiktok-hook-examples): 50+ proven hook examples organized by format (POV, number, bold-claim, question, call-out hooks).
- [25 TikTok Video Ideas That Consistently Go Viral](https://viralhooks.app/blog/25-tiktok-video-ideas-that-consistently-go-viral-2026)
- [Best Viral TikTok Ideas for Faceless Creators](https://viralhooks.app/blog/best-viral-tiktok-ideas-for-faceless-creators-2026)
